items.title: Selective Insurance Appoints Jacob E. Rothfuss as Standard Lines President
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, the New Jersey-based insurer has recruited the Velocity CEO to lead its standard commercial and personal lines businesses.

items.title: Ransomware Incidents Surge by Over 50 Percent in the Third Quarter
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, according to threat exposure management platform NordLayer, global ransomware attacks reached a record high in Q3 2026, driven by new threat groups and changing tactics.

items.title: Gallagher Re Cites APAC Insurance Opportunities
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, an abundance of reinsurance capital and artificial intelligence trends are creating fresh growth opportunities for insurers across the Asia-Pacific region, according to a report by Gallagher Re.

items.title: Construction Safety Threatened by Workforce Shortages
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, experts at the annual IRMI Construction Risk Conference warn that better safety programmes alone cannot resolve industry safety issues driven by high staff turnover and a lack of experienced workers.

items.title: Brown & Brown Posts Third-Quarter Revenue Rise
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, uS broker Brown & Brown reports third-quarter organic revenue growth of 1.2% amidst a challenging rate environment, while total revenues climbed 7.4% to $1.7 billion.

items.title: Utah’s Lower Alcohol Limit Linked to Drop in Crashes, Study Finds
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, an Insurance Institute for Highway Safety study reveals Utah experienced a reduction in alcohol-related crashes after lowering its legal blood alcohol concentration limit to 0.05%.
